description: Run one bounded process under a PTY using operator-approved executable and working roots. Produces Process Capture v4; legacy v3 captures cannot be upgraded and must be recaptured with this tool. Requires approved: true; unknown_registry_approved: true separately records capture residuals. Captures raw and xterm-rendered terminal frames, scripted interactions, lifecycle filesystem checkpoints, process ownership, declarative command shims, and loopback replay. Disabled unless operator policy enables it; not a security sandbox.
